title: A customer's theme
description: A customer's brand on their own surfaces in AppSpring (hub D-103 item 4, D-117; ui D-34, D-45): accent, surface tint, chart slots, the app's own state colours and logo, values only, never geometry. The shape only: @forspring/ui's validateTheme() also checks contrast (errors), closeness to the status colours and between states and chart neighbours (warnings) and the logo's URL, and refuses the Guideline level until it ships.

$schema.description: This file's path, for an editor: node_modules/@forspring/ui/schema/customer-theme.schema.json.

level.description: default: Forspring's look. brand: accent, tint, chart slots, states and logo. guideline: brand plus an approved font and a radius and a density preset (hub D-117; not available yet).

color.description: #rrggbb, or a DTCG 2025.10 srgb colour value, opaque.

pair.description: A colour per theme. Without dark, validateTheme() derives one and checks it.

colorOrPair.description: A colour (the light value; validateTheme() derives the dark one) or a colour per theme.

source.description: An https: URL, a data:image/ URL or a relative path in the app's bundle.

accent.description: Buttons, links, focus and the doll: at least 4.5:1 on background, card and muted, its label 4.5:1 on it. Within 10 (OKLab x100) of a status or signal colour is a warning.

tint.description: The page and soft surface: every text role at least 4.5:1 on it, every signal mark 3:1.

charts.description: chart-1 first: each at least 3:1 on the page and the card; neighbours under 15 apart (8 under colour-vision simulation) are a warning. chart-N-tint is derived.

states.description: The app's own state keys (enum or lifecycle values) to their colour: at least 3:1 on background, card and muted, a label 4.5:1 on it. Emitted as --state-<key>, --state-<key>-foreground and --state-<key>-soft.

alt.description: What a screen reader says for the logo.

font.description: One of the approved fonts (none yet).
